name: Numerology
overview: Scripture clearly warns against engaging in practices such as observing times or using enchantments, which are associated with divination and occult activities forbidden by God (Leviticus 19:26; Deuteronomy 18:10). Believers are instructed to avoid seeking guidance from familiar spirits or wizards, as these defile and dishonor the Lord (Leviticus 19:31). Rather than attributing spiritual power or significance to numbers or celestial bodies, God's people are called to worship Him alone, resisting the temptation to serve created things such as the sun, moon, and stars (Deuteronomy 4:19). These commands underscore the biblical rejection of numerology and related occult practices as contrary to a Christ-centered faith.
